rituals.name: The Uncounted Lamp
rituals.finch: Finch reviews and routes a request if she chooses; maintenance controls inspection and repair.
rituals.effect: A formerly unregistered fixture becomes a recognized service object; actual illumination requires an independently authorized repair.

rituals.name: The Missing Pair
rituals.occasion: Clean clothes or bedding not reaching an individual
rituals.finch: Finch may check allocation and request replacement; steward retains custody.
rituals.effect: The person's belongings become individually addressable in a previously aggregate inventory.

rituals.name: The Undelivered Letter
rituals.occasion: A resident wishes to restore correspondence
rituals.finch: Finch may arrange ordinary review; resident and recipient retain control.
rituals.effect: An interrupted correspondence route becomes available for an independently chosen delivery.

rituals.name: The Unreturned Book
rituals.occasion: A book or intellectual interest lost in an inconsistent register
rituals.finch: Finch may route discrepancy to librarian; librarian decides loan or correction.
rituals.effect: A title previously absent from the active catalogue can be requested again.

rituals.name: The Cold Cell
rituals.finch: Finch may request inspection or additional bedding; ordinary immediate assistance remains independent.
rituals.effect: A forgotten room enters the service map with addressable repair history.

rituals.name: The Unoccupied Chair
rituals.occasion: A desired visitor relationship is missing from current records
rituals.finch: Finch may route a request; both parties and authorized visitation staff must independently agree.
rituals.effect: A previously closed scheduling possibility becomes legible without guaranteeing a visit.

rituals.name: The Missing Place
rituals.occasion: A resident's documented meal allocation does not match their needs
rituals.finch: Finch may route an allocation discrepancy; kitchen or relevant professional retains decision authority.
rituals.effect: An overlooked individual becomes addressable in the meal ledger, without inferring medical need.

rituals.name: The Appointment That Never Was
rituals.occasion: A resident wants to revisit a canceled appointment
rituals.finch: Finch may arrange a new review; provider and resident decide independently.
rituals.effect: A canceled possibility can reenter the scheduling horizon; history remains unchanged.

rituals.name: The Owner of the Empty Shelf
rituals.occasion: An item is separated from its recognized owner
rituals.finch: Finch may forward an ownership inquiry; authorized custodian must decide.
rituals.effect: An item acquires a reviewable association with its claimant, not automatic ownership.

rituals.name: The Unsigned Departure
rituals.occasion: A legitimate discharge document contains a discrepancy
rituals.finch: Finch can route a discrepancy but cannot grant discharge outside her authority.
rituals.effect: A valid review opportunity opens; confinement and release require independent lawful decision. No shortcut.
